kicker: Pick your crew. Learn your matchups. Understand your decisions.
description: A One Piece TCG deck builder and AI trainer. Build your crew, practise against meta decks, and improve with evidence-backed turn coaching.
detail_description: Build and version decks from a real card catalogue, choose alternate artwork, and inspect deck legality, colour compatibility, cost distribution, and counters.

Practise against AI opponents using a curated library of meta decks. A deterministic game engine validates and resolves actions, while the AI chooses moves using only the information available to its side.
Get turn-by-turn coaching during play or after the game. RAG over official rules, card rulings, and curated community strategy guides grounds advice in sources you can inspect.

Explore opponent and coaching workflows in a React Flow execution graph, including retrieved evidence, action validation, timing, token usage, and errors. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and pgvector; currently in development.
